_meta.purpose: Pre-resolved registry values for downstream agents. Agents consuming this file do NOT need to load raw registry files.

spec_identity.notes: Fifth interior RP spec (after SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP, SF_DRYWALL_CEILING_INT_RP, SF_TRIM_INT_RP, SF_DOOR_INT_RP). Combined assessment + prep + prime + finish for previously painted interior window units. Context prefix WNRP (WiNdow RePaint) confirmed — no collision with existing prefixes. TSK_WIN_* is NC window (29 tasks). TSK_WLRP_* is wall RP. TSK_CLRP_* is ceiling RP. TSK_TMRP_* is trim RP. TSK_DIRP_* is door RP. WNRP avoids all collisions. Verified: zero TSK_WNRP_* IDs exist in id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use.

paintable_items.name: Window unit (frame, sash, muntins)
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_WINDOW_INT_NC. Same physical assembly in RP context. EA-based with Size Bucket Method (S/M/L/O) for rate scaling. Counted per window opening.

paintable_items.name: Extension jamb / reveal
paintable_items.notes: Reuse existing item from SF_WINDOW_INT_NC. Same physical element in RP context. May not be present on all windows (some have no extension jamb).

task_prefix.collision_check: No collision. TSK_WIN_* is NC window (SF_WINDOW_INT_NC_v1, 29 tasks). TSK_XWIN_* is exterior NC window. TSK_WLRP_* is wall RP. TSK_CLRP_* is ceiling RP. TSK_TMRP_* is trim RP. TSK_DIRP_* is door interior RP. TSK_WNRP_* is unique for interior window RP. Checked against id_registry.json context_prefixes_in_use — WNRP not present.
task_prefix.naming_rule: TSK_WNRP_{ACTION} — action should be verb-based (ASSESS_CONDITION, ASSESS_ADHESION, ASSESS_COATING_ID, ASSESS_MOISTURE, ASSESS_GLAZING, ASSESS_SASH_OP, DEGLOSS, SCRAPE_FEATHER, WASH_TSP, PRIME_BRUSH, FINISH_BRUSH_1, etc.). ALL tasks in this combined RP spec use the WNRP_ prefix — both RP-new tasks and tasks adapted from NC window specs. Direct NC task transfers are re-issued under TSK_WNRP_* for prefix consistency.

expected_modules.notes: Floor protection (perimeter brush / 8ft radius spray), glass masking (mandatory, 30-40% of total time for TDL), wall masking (RP always — walls are finished), hardware handling (remove or mask), furniture/window treatment management (RP-specific). Mostly DIRECT transfers from NC MOD_WIN_SETUP + RP furniture task.

RP-specific: condition inspection (all window surfaces), adhesion test (ASTM D3359), coating ID (latex vs alkyd solvent test), moisture check (sill/jamb bottoms/sash bottom rail), glazing compound assessment (older windows), sash operation test (pre-paint). Assessment maps to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. FIXED time tasks.

TSP wash, degloss (chemical or mechanical), scrape/feather for failing/peeling paint, mildew treatment (biocide for moisture damage), rust treatment (steel substrate — modified from NC), caulk assess/repair, glazing repair (scope-limited to <20% of perimeter), scuff sand, clean dust. Condition-driven task activation. EA-based rates with size/type/muntin/height/condition modifiers.

State-driven primer: SYS_PRIMER_ADHESION_INT (alkyd existing or adhesion failure), SYS_PRIMER_STAINBLOCK_INT (smoke/nicotine — shellac BIN), SYS_PRIMER_MILDEW_INT (moisture damage with mildew). Conditional on substrate_state. Brush/spray variants. No primer for SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT with good adhesion test + latex existing coating.

Fine-finish interstage protocol at all tiers: inspect coat, sand between coats (QT3 spot 220, QT4 full 220, QT5 thorough 320), patch/repair defects, spot coat, clean dust. Runs between each coat pair. Transfers DIRECT from NC — identical once surface is prepped and primed.

Finish coat application — brush or spray. 2 coats standard (QT3-QT4), 3 coats QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3. Finish coat rates transfer DIRECT from NC: brush coat 1 at 3.5 EA/hr, brush coat 2 at 4 EA/hr, spray coat 1 at 8 EA/hr, spray coat 2 at 10 EA/hr. Fine-finish coating systems: SYS_FF_STANDARD_ACRYLIC (QT3), SYS_FF_MODIFIED_URETHANE (QT4), SYS_FF_PREMIUM (QT5).

Protection teardown, hardware reinstall, glass scraping after cure, sash break at 24/48 hr to prevent adhesion bond, floor protection removal, furniture/window treatment replacement, customer walkthrough (RP-specific), tool clean, final inspection.

Shared lead-safe RRP module. Conditional on PS_META.BOOL.HOME_PRE_1978. Shared across all interior RP specs. Pre-existing shared module — not owned by this spec. Windows are HIGH RISK for lead — friction surfaces (operable sashes) are the #1 residential lead dust generator.

paintscope_keys.description: Count of small windows (S bucket, ~8 LF perimeter). Size modifier 0.75x.
Count of medium windows (M bucket, ~12 LF perimeter). Baseline 1.00x.
Count of large windows (L bucket, ~17 LF perimeter). Size modifier 1.40x.
Count of oversized windows (O bucket, measured perimeter).
Total window count in scope. Sum of S+M+L+O. Drives per-project fixed-time tasks.
Windows at height tier H1 (standard, ground floor). Modifier 1.00x.
Windows at height tier H2 (step ladder). Modifier 1.30x.
Windows at height tier H3 (extension ladder). Modifier 1.50x. Rare in interior RP.
Windows at height tier H4. Modifier 2.00x. Very rare interior.
Windows at height tier H5. Modifier 2.50x. Extremely rare interior.
Exception windows requiring measured estimates outside size bucket method.
Total glass area for masking. Drives glass masking rate (60 SF/hr from NC).
Floor protection area for brush method drip containment.
Radial floor protection for spray method overspray containment.
Wall masking LF around window openings. In RP, required for BOTH brush and spray (walls finished in occupied homes).
Hardware group count for masking/removal tasks (locks, latches, crank operators).
Sill/stool protection LF for spray method.
Surface condition enum (GOOD/FAIR/POOR) for condition modifier selection.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). RP-specific condition assessment driving prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Interior substrate state classification (SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT through SS_INT_SMOKE_DAMAGE). Drives primer selection logic.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Distinct from SURFACE_CONDITION which drives prep intensity.

paintscope_keys.description: Boolean flag indicating home built before 1978, triggering RRP lead-safe module.
paintscope_keys.notes: Shared with SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP (proposed there first). Windows are HIGH RISK for lead paint — friction surfaces.

paintscope_keys.description: Contamination type: none, mildew, smoke, water_stain. Drives primer selection and treatment task activation.
Room count — drives per-room heuristics (customer walkthrough, fixed-time tasks).

quality_tier.notes: QT3 minimum for windows (fine-finish scope). QT modifiers for windows use GLOBAL values: QT3=1.0x, QT4=1.3x, QT5=1.5x (NOT door-specific overrides of 1.4x/1.8x). Windows are fine-finish but not as heavily scrutinized as doors.

application_method.notes: Brush is default for RP (occupied home, fewer windows). Spray for production work (8-12+ windows breakeven). Roll is NOT valid for windows. spray_backroll not applicable.

sheen.notes: Semi-gloss is traditional window sheen (requires QT4+). Satin acceptable at QT3. Gloss at QT5 only. Flat/matte/eggshell NOT valid for windows per Fine_Finish_Doctrine.

phase.notes: Assessment tasks map to 'prep' phase — no 'assessment' phase value exists in controlled_enums. 'apply' omitted from values because spec uses prime/finish directly.

unit_of_measure.notes: EA for per-window tasks (primary). SF for glass masking and floor protection. LF for wall masking and sill protection. EA_ROOM for per-room heuristics. FIXED for assessment and customer walkthrough.

substrate_state.notes: All 5 interior RP substrate states accepted. Output normalizes to standard SS_PAINTED_* per selected sheen. Semi-gloss is traditional window sheen. Worst-state-wins for v1 — single substrate_state input per window.

condition_scale.notes: Universal 3-level condition scale per controlled_enums.json. Drives prep pool modifier: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.

consumable_category.notes: All categories valid for window RP. 'tool' covers assessment kit. 'prep' covers TSP solution, deglosser, biocide, glazing compound.

product_role.notes: Primer = state-driven RP primers. Finish = fine-finish QT-driven systems. Specialty = shellac stain blocker, biocide, wood hardener.

yield_uom.notes: EA for per-window consumables. SF for coverage-based consumables. GAL for product yield.

protection_level.notes: edge_only for floor_perimeter (brush). full_cover for floor_full_8ft_radius (spray) and glass_mask. partial_cover for hardware_covers and furniture_adjacent. light_mask for wall_adjacent_window and sill_protection.

floor_type.notes: RP ALWAYS has finished floors. Subfloor and partial not applicable to interior RP.

modifier_mechanism.notes: QT3=baseline (1.0x), QT4=selective_multiplier (1.3x on qt_scaled tasks — global modifiers for windows), QT5=selective_multiplier (1.5x) + additional_rounds (coat 3 brush per FFD 15.10.3).

surface_ids.primary_surface_note: window_frame is representative for frame component. window_sash, window_muntin, window_jamb are additional primary surfaces. All are existing surface IDs.
surface_ids.notes: All surface IDs are existing in id_registry.json surface_ids entries_in_active_use. window_frame: frame assembly. window_sash: operable sash(es). window_muntin: TDL muntins. window_jamb: extension jamb/reveal. window_casing: trim (covered by SF_TRIM_INT_RP). wall_field: walls adjacent to window. window_stool: stool/apron (covered by SF_TRIM_INT_RP). window_glass: glass panes (not painted — masking only).

zone_ids.notes: Runner-style drop cloth along window work perimeter. Brush method only. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Full radial floor coverage around window spray zone. 8 ft radius from each window. Spray method only. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Paper/film masking on all window glass panes. MANDATORY regardless of method. Largest single protection task (30-40% of total time on TDL). Transfers DIRECT from NC.
Tape/bag or remove window hardware (locks, latches, crank operators). Transfers DIRECT from NC. RP: existing hardware may have paint buildup requiring scoring before removal.
Wall masking around window perimeter. MODIFIED from NC: RP requires wall masking for BOTH spray and brush methods (walls are finished in occupied homes). NC only masks walls for spray.
Protect stool/sill from overspray. Spray method only. Transfers DIRECT from NC.
RP-specific: cover or move furniture near windows in occupied homes. Window treatments (curtains, blinds) removed or pinned/covered. Not present in NC. Shared with other interior RP specs.

material_system_prefix.notes: All 6 material systems are existing/shared. Three RP primer systems (adhesion, stain-block, mildew) are shared with wall RP and other interior RP specs (proposed in SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP resolution). Three fine-finish systems (QT3/QT4/QT5) are shared with NC window, NC door, NC trim, and all other fine-finish specs. Waterborne alkyd or urethane enamels recommended for windows due to blocking resistance on operable sashes. No new material systems needed for this spec.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Liquid Sander / Deglosser
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Chemical degloss for existing paint on complex window profiles. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: RP Assessment Kit (Adhesion + Coating ID)
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_TRIM_INT_RP resolution. Cross-hatch cutter, tape (ASTM D3359), mineral spirits, white rags. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: TSP (Trisodium Phosphate) Cleaner
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_DOOR_INT_RP resolution. Surface decontamination wash. Shared across interior RP specs.

shared_rp_consumables.name: Wood Hardener / Consolidant
shared_rp_consumables.notes: RP-specific. Proposed in SF_DOOR_INT_RP resolution. For moisture-softened sills and sash bottoms. Conditional on SS_INT_MOISTURE_DAMAGE + soft substrate.

proposed_consumables.name: Mildewcide / Biocide Solution
proposed_consumables.justification: For mildew treatment on moisture-damaged window sills and jamb bottoms. Required 24 hr dry before priming. Windows are the #1 interior mildew site due to condensation. May have been proposed in wall RP consumables — verify before creating duplicate.

proposed_consumables.name: Glazing Compound (Acrylic or DAP)
proposed_consumables.justification: Window-specific RP consumable for spot repair of failed glazing compound on older single-pane and TDL windows. Not used in NC (new windows have IG units). Not applicable to any other spec family.

proposed_consumables.name: Glass Scraper (Single-Edge Razor)
proposed_consumables.justification: For post-cure glass cleaning — remove paint from glass panes after masking teardown. Transfers from NC implicitly but never formalized as a consumable. Useful for both NC and RP window specs.

proposed_rounds.description: State-driven prime + 2 finish coats. Standard RP sequence for FAIR/POOR condition windows requiring primer.
proposed_rounds.notes: Most common RP round for windows with adhesion failure, moisture damage, or smoke contamination. Prime coat is state-driven (adhesion, stain-block, or mildew primer).

proposed_rounds.description: 2 finish coats only. GOOD condition, no prime needed — sound paint with adhesion verified and compatible coating.
proposed_rounds.notes: Skip prime when adhesion test passes, existing paint is sound, coating is latex over latex. Most common residential window repaint scenario (cosmetic refresh).

proposed_rounds.description: Prime + 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: Maximum coat sequence for windows. State-driven prime + 3 brush finish coats with thorough interstage at 320 grit.

proposed_rounds.description: 3 finish coats. QT5 + brush + GOOD condition.
proposed_rounds.notes: QT5 brush adds 3rd finish coat per FFD 15.10.3 even without prime.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for adhesion primer on previously painted window surfaces. Lower absorption than bare-wood primer.
proposed_profiles.notes: Previously painted surfaces absorb less primer than bare wood. Expect ~12-15 EA/gal for medium windows.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for shellac stain blocker on smoke-damaged window surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Shellac primers have lower coverage than latex primers. Expect ~8-10 EA/gal for medium windows.

proposed_profiles.description: Coverage rate for fine-finish enamel on repainted window surfaces.
proposed_profiles.notes: Similar to NC finish coverage on previously painted substrate. COV_WIN_FINISH may be reusable — Materials Manager to evaluate.

existing_modifiers_to_reuse.notes: Shared per instruction. Drives prep pool: GOOD=1.0x, FAIR=1.5x, POOR=2.0x.
Shared per instruction. Drives treatment task activation and primer selection.

existing_modifiers_from_nc.notes: Transfers from NC unchanged. S=0.75x, M=1.00x (baseline), L=1.40x, O=measured. Applied per EA for all per-window tasks.
Transfers from NC unchanged. DH=1.00x, casement=0.96x, slider=0.96x, fixed=0.78x, awning=1.00x.
Transfers from NC unchanged. TDL +20% on application and sanding tasks.
Transfers from NC. H1=1.00x, H2=1.30x, H3=1.50x, H4=2.00x, H5=2.50x.

prep_pool.formula: condition_modifier x size_modifier x type_modifier x muntin_modifier x height_modifier
prep_pool.flag_note: At 4.0x flag threshold but represents extreme worst case (large TDL double-hung at height in POOR condition). More realistic max: POOR(2.0) x M(1.00) x DH(1.00) x no_TDL(1.00) x H1(1.00) = 2.0x.

coating_pool.formula: qt_modifier x size_modifier x type_modifier x muntin_modifier x height_modifier
coating_pool.flag_note: Under 4.0x flag. Window QT modifiers are global (lower than door-specific) keeping coating pool well within bounds.

coordination_notes: Window RP runs alongside trim RP (SF_TRIM_INT_RP) which covers window casing and stool. Casing and stool are often painted in the same session if same finish.
Window RP may run alongside wall RP (SF_DRYWALL_WALL_INT_RP) in full interior repaint. Wall masking for windows may already be in place from wall RP spray setup.
MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT is shared across all interior RP specs — do not duplicate lead-safe tasks. Windows are especially HIGH RISK for lead due to friction surfaces.
Wall masking zone (wall_adjacent_window) is needed for BOTH brush and spray in RP — unlike NC where brush doesn't require wall masking.
Furniture/window treatment protection (furniture_adjacent zone) is RP-specific — not coordinated with any NC spec.

cross_file_threading: RULE 1: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json MUST have a matching rate in production.json
RULE 2: Every ITM_ in spec.json MUST appear in at least one variant
RULE 3: Every SYS_ quality_tier MUST match spec.json configuration_dimensions
RULE 4: Every IN_ input in spec.json SHOULD be consumed by sop_modules or production
RULE 5: Every PS_ key in production.json MUST match spec.json required_paintscope_inputs
RULE 6: Every zone_id in spec.json MUST match sop_modules.json protection_metadata.zones
RULE 7: Module phase order: setup -> prep -> prime -> apply -> interstage -> finish -> cleanup
RULE 8: UOM for a task MUST match between sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 9: Every TSK_ context prefix from resolution.json MUST be used in sop_modules.json and production.json
RULE 10: Every ITM_ marked 'existing' in resolution.json MUST use the exact registered ID
RULE 11: Downstream agents MUST use only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Window Repaint (Combined Assessment + Prep + Prime + Finish)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New spec family for interior window repaint. Covers window unit (frame, sash, muntins) + extension jamb, combined prime + finish. No existing SF_ covers interior window RP.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Window Repaint Task Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New context prefix WNRP for interior window RP tasks (~42 tasks). Avoids collision with TSK_WIN_* (NC window, 29 tasks), TSK_XWIN_* (exterior NC window), TSK_WLRP_* (wall RP), TSK_CLRP_* (ceiling RP), TSK_TMRP_* (trim RP), TSK_DIRP_* (door interior RP).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Interior Window Repaint Module Prefix
registry_additions_proposed.justification: New module prefix for 7 WNRP modules (setup, assessment, prep, prime, interstage, finish, cleanup) + shared MOD_RRP_INT_CONTAINMENT.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window RP: State-Driven Prime + 2 Finish Coats
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific round with conditional state-driven prime. Not equivalent to existing ROUND_WIN_PRIME_2FINISH (NC, substrate-driven prime).

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window RP: 2 Finish Coats (No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP GOOD condition round — skip prime when adhesion verified. Distinct from ROUND_WIN_2FINISH because RP context has different preconditions.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window RP: Prime + 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Maximum coat sequence for QT5 brush per FFD 15.10.3 + FAIR/POOR condition.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Window RP: 3 Finish Coats (QT5 Brush, No Prime)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: QT5 brush 3-coat sequence for GOOD condition. No prime needed.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Adhesion Primer Coverage on Painted Window Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific coverage rate — adhesion primer on previously painted windows differs from bare-wood primer coverage.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Shellac Stain Blocker Coverage on Window Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Shellac primers have distinct coverage rate from latex/adhesion primers.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Fine-Finish Enamel Coverage on Repainted Window Surfaces
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific finish coverage — may reuse COV_WIN_FINISH. Materials Manager to evaluate.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Mildewcide / Biocide Solution
registry_additions_proposed.justification: For mildew treatment on moisture-damaged window sills/jambs. Windows are the #1 interior mildew site due to condensation. Verify not already proposed in earlier RP spec.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Glazing Compound (Acrylic or DAP)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: Window-specific consumable for spot repair of failed glazing on older single-pane and TDL windows. Not applicable to any other spec family.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Glass Scraper (Single-Edge Razor)
registry_additions_proposed.justification: For post-cure glass cleaning. Implicitly used in NC but never formalized as a consumable. Useful for both NC and RP window specs.

registry_additions_proposed.name: Furniture/Window Treatment Protection Zone
registry_additions_proposed.justification: RP-specific zone for covering or moving furniture and window treatments near windows in occupied homes. Shared with other interior RP specs. May already be proposed in wall/ceiling RP — verify before creating duplicate.
